candidate_identity: canonical sha256 of hypothesis_id, specification_hash, parameter_hash, target_symbol, session_date, direction, state timestamps, causal_cutoff, first_legal_entry_timestamp, input_symbol_set, history_hash
confirmation_formula: laggard completed close crosses its own opening range edge in leader direction within 15 completed minutes after 09:45
direction_rule: leader direction is sign(close_09:45 / open_09:15 - 1); target direction equals leader direction after laggard confirmation
entry_event: first completed confirmation bar satisfying formula; entry uses next completed bar close reference
entry_price_reference: underlying close at first legal entry timestamp; never option price
first_legal_timestamp: next completed one-minute bar after confirmation; same-bar entry prohibited
future_suffix_behavior: bars after causal cutoff must not change candidate ID, direction, entry timestamp, score, parameter hash, or history hash through cutoff
input_universe: 500 old-epoch complete development sessions only; no post-2026-07-10 prospective sessions; required NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX one-minute underlying OHLCV
invalidation: leader closes back inside its opening range before laggard confirmation
leader_symbol_or_basket_owner: index with largest absolute normalized displacement at 09:45 among NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX; ties broken by NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX order
mechanism_family: cross-index leadership propagation after asynchronous opening displacement
missing_data_behavior: fail closed with deterministic rejection code; no synthetic/mock/fallback rows accepted
multiple_setup_behavior: duplicates rejected after first emitted candidate per target symbol-session or market-session as stated
opening_window_definition: all minute offsets are completed bars from 09:15 IST session open; timestamp alignment exact across required indices

laggard_confirmation_fraction.formula: laggard close beyond range edge by fraction*range
laggard_confirmation_fraction.name: laggard_confirmation_fraction

leader_acceptance_fraction.formula: leader close beyond range edge by fraction*range
leader_acceptance_fraction.name: leader_acceptance_fraction

leader_observation_minutes.formula: 09:15 through 09:44 completed bars; observation at 09:45 close
leader_observation_minutes.name: leader_observation_minutes

min_leader_displacement_bps.name: min_leader_displacement_bps
min_leader_displacement_bps.structural_rationale: material opening displacement without raw point scale

primary_outcome: direction-normalized underlying bps from entry close to primary_horizon_minutes; development only, not prospective lockbox
prior_session_dependency: required only where specified by state machine; missing required prior session fails closed
same_bar_behavior: same-bar entry prohibited; confirmation bar cannot be entry bar; pause/compression completion and breakout on the same bar is rejected unless breakout occurs on later completed bar
setup_expiry: as specified by parameterized setup expiry or final state-machine window; after expiry reject SETUP_EXPIRED
single_emission_scope: one candidate per hypothesis/session/target symbol except AC11/AC13 market tie rules emit first deterministic target only
state_machine: require all three aligned one-minute sessions
compute first-30-minute opening range and 09:45 displacement for each index
leader = max abs(displacement_bps) with deterministic tie order
laggard candidates = indices with abs(displacement_bps) <= max_laggard_displacement_bps and still inside their first-30-minute range at 09:45
leader accepted if 09:45 close is outside leader opening range in leader direction by >= leader_acceptance_fraction * leader opening range
wait up to confirmation_window_minutes for first laggard close outside its own opening range in leader direction by >= laggard_confirmation_fraction * laggard range
emit the first confirming laggard only; tie same timestamp by NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX
structural_premise: One index opens with accepted displacement while another remains inside opening balance; continuation is expected only after the laggard confirms.
tie_breaking: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX deterministic order unless not applicable
